_about: Explicit corrections and additions applied on top of steam_api.json. The SDK headers are the ground truth; every entry names the header it comes from and why steam_api.json alone is not enough. tests/abi verifies all of it against the headers with clang.

ignoredHeaders._reason: Headers outside the flat API that the generator does not scan: isteammusicremote.h does not compile against this SDK (k_iSteamMusicRemoteCallbacks is undefined) and ISteamMusicRemote has no flat functions; the PS3 headers are obsolete.

enumBaseTypes._reason: steam_api.json records enumerators as signed 32-bit values. ERemoteStoragePlatform::k_ERemoteStoragePlatformAll is 0xffffffff in isteamremotestorage.h, which makes the C++ underlying type unsigned int with GCC and Clang (MSVC keeps int; the size is 4 bytes either way).

typedefReplacements.name: intp
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: pointer-sized (long long on 64-bit targets, int on 32-bit); steam_api.json only records the 64-bit spelling.

typedefReplacements.name: uintp
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: pointer-sized (unsigned long long on 64-bit targets, unsigned int on 32-bit).

typedefReplacements.name: lint64
typedefReplacements.d: version (Windows) alias lint64 = long; else alias lint64 = c_long;
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: __int64 with MSVC but `long int` elsewhere, which is 32 bits on 32-bit Linux.

typedefReplacements.name: ulint64
typedefReplacements.d: version (Windows) alias ulint64 = ulong; else alias ulint64 = c_ulong;
typedefReplacements.reason: steamtypes.h: unsigned __int64 with MSVC but `unsigned long int` elsewhere.

manualTypes._reason: Types the generator cannot express from steam_api.json (unions, bitfields, nested types, C++ inline members). They are written by hand in the named modules and verified by tests/abi like every generated type.

manualClasses._reason: Hand-written extern(C++) classes (steamworks.raw.manual). The flat API passes them by pointer, which is a class reference in D.

manualProbe._reason: C++ field lists of hand-written types for the ABI probe. Keys are C++ qualified names.

manualEnumsProbe._reason: Hand-written enums checked by the ABI probe: D qualified name to C++ qualified name and enumerators.

manualConstsProbe._reason: Hand-written constants checked by the ABI probe: D qualified name to C++ expression.

jsonOnlyStructs._reason: Only forward-declared in the public headers (defined in steamdatagram_gamecoordinator.h, which the SDK does not ship). Their layout comes from steam_api.json; every field is naturally aligned, so the layout does not depend on packing.

opaqueTypes.name: SteamDatagramRelayAuthTicket
opaqueTypes.doc: Only forward-declared in the SDK (defined in steamdatagram_tickets.h, which the SDK does not ship).

extraStructs.doc: Sentinel the headers use to assert the callback packing: 24 bytes with VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK_SMALL, 32 with VALVE_CALLBACK_PACK_LARGE.

jsonOnlyConsts._reason: Present in steam_api.json but defined in headers the SDK does not ship, so the ABI probe cannot check them.

cppInterfaces._reason: C++ callback interfaces the game implements and passes to ISteamMatchmakingServers. Emitted as extern(C++) abstract classes so a D subclass has the vtable layout Steam expects.

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_InitFlat
extraFunctions.doc: Initializes the Steam API for flat-API users, checking the interface versions this binding was generated for. Prefer SteamAPI_InitEx, which mirrors the C++ inline function.

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_Shutdown
extraFunctions.doc: Shuts down the Steam API.

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_RestartAppIfNecessary

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_ReleaseCurrentThreadMemory

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_WriteMiniDump

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_SetMiniDumpComment

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_IsSteamRunning

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_GetSteamInstallPath

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_SetTryCatchCallbacks

extraFunctions.name: SteamAPI_InitSafe

unboundExports._reason: Symbols exported by libsteam_api that the SDK headers do not declare (legacy or internal). They are intentionally not bound; tests compare this list with the library's export table.
